# Unit tests: power-up effects, timer refresh & magnet math

## Summary
TDD test feature for per-type effects in the GymPowerUps gym (AH-0MTC0QPS60005MNT): P5 +50% speed for 10 s with refresh-on-recollect, P8 +1 life (start 3, cap 5, excess ignored), P9 stack cap 5 + radius/attraction math. Contracts for implementation F6.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] **AC1:** P5 tests assert +50% thrust/max-speed applied live to the ship's movement for 10 s, then removed.
- [ ] **AC2:** P5 tests assert re-collecting an active P5 refreshes the timer to full duration (10 s) — not additive, not ignored.
- [ ] **AC3:** P8 tests assert +1 life immediately, lives counter starts at 3, caps at 5, excess pickups ignored.
- [ ] **AC4:** P9 tests assert one stack per pickup up to cap 5; pickups beyond 5 are no-ops.
- [ ] **AC5:** P9 tests assert magnet radius = 2 × ship size +50% per stack, and attraction speed is slower than the ship's max speed.

## Key Files:
- src/powerups/effects.test.ts — new unit tests
- src/core/constants.ts / src/core/config.ts — values under test (ship size, max speed)

## Dependencies
- Parent: AH-0MTC0QPS60005MNT
- Contract for: Power-up catalogue + effects for P5/P8/P9 (AH-<TBD>)
